result.instructions: Tools for Maqplan ERP, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "List the first 20 customers of our ERP company."; "Show sales order 1234 with its details."; "Show the newest invoices in our ERP, latest first.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Maqplan ERP data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run maqplan_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run maqplan_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run maqplan_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. maqplan_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: maqplan_get_company
tools.title: Get the company
tools.description: Get the ERP company that the API key belongs to. ERP API: GET /api/Empresas/obterempresa.

tools.name: maqplan_list_branches
tools.title: List branches
tools.description: List branches (filiais) of the ERP company and branch that the API key belongs to. Filter with where, order, limit and skip. ERP API: GET /api/Filials.

where.description: Field conditions, for example {"uf":"SC"} or {"id":{"gt":0}}. Uses the Maqplan filter syntax.

skip.description: Rows to skip. For large lists prefer where {"id":{"gt":<last id>}} with order "id ASC".

tools.name: maqplan_get_branch
tools.title: Get a branch
tools.description: Get one branch (filial) by id, with all its fields. ERP API: GET /api/Filials/{id}.

id.description: The record id (from the matching list tool).
